title: Tap Super (left Option) alone -> F19 (Hammerspoon turns it into Activities)

rules.description: Tap left Option (Super) alone -> F19, which Hammerspoon turns into Activities. Detected here, not in Hammerspoon, because Karabiner sees every key that should cancel a tap (including ones AltTab eats) and none of its own synthetic modifier releases. Hammerspoon vetoes it if the mouse was used while Super was held, because Karabiner can't see the trackpad.
